descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Jubilee' 'Jubilee' Reticulated Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Jubilee' has a spectacular pink reticulated variegation in the spring. The pink fades to cream with a pink blush over pink reticulated veins with chartreuse highlights. Fall color is a bright crimson to scarlet red. I would expect 'Jubilee' to get 6-8 ft in 10 years. Give 'Jubilee' protection from the hot afternoon sun for best color. 'Jubilee' is a new selection that was recently introduced by Talon Buchholz.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Jubilee' 'Jubilee' 网脉斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 'Jubilee' 春季具有非常惊艳的粉色网脉斑锦。 粉色随后褪为奶油色，并带有粉色晕染；粉色网脉在黄绿色映衬下尤为醒目。 秋色为鲜亮的深红至猩红色。 我预计 'Jubilee' 10 年可长至 6-8 英尺。 为获得最佳叶色，建议为 'Jubilee' 提供午后烈日遮荫。 'Jubilee' 是 Talon Buchholz 最近推出的一个新品种。 带有 MrMaple 标识的照片
